data.narrative:
Endurance Energy is a SPAC-stage climate and energy company founded by Andrew Redd, having raised $5M+ to date. The valuation universe for Climate & Energy comprises one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

Standard peer-median methodology is not applicable here. The Climate & Energy sector yields eight same-sector peers, but none satisfy the filtering criteria required for robust triangulation—specifically, zero peers matched the same stage, zero at adjacent stages, and zero at similar valuation tiers. A median derived from all eight peers would conflate materially different risk profiles and development phases, rendering the result uninformative for valuation purposes.

Given the absence of a credible peer-median anchor, this analysis cannot support a specific valuation range without additional data on comparable transaction multiples, the target's underlying unit economics, or capital efficiency relative to the peer set. Key uncertainties include the company's current financial metrics (revenue, burn rate), the stage and ticket sizes of recent fundraising rounds within the peer cohort, and the applicability of the single public comparable across divergent technology vectors within climate and energy. Further data collection on same-stage or adjacent-stage private fundraising and the peer set's revenue multiples would be required to triangulate a defensible range.
